prompt_fragment: This asset is a card face. Compose for a vertical 3:4 frame with a strong focal subject and room for card framing or overlay treatment.
raw_description:
Upper half: a Before Times relic in a deep vault — impossible shard on a
carved volcanic-glass pedestal, serial numbers ("8H-H1Y0B") faintly
phosphorescent on its face. Aurora-crystal shards arranged in a warding
pattern around it. Robed ice-readers watch from a safe distance, one with
a shaking hand raised. A halo of cold wrongness around the relic.
Lower half: warm dark surface for text with a ghosted serial-number
watermark. Warm cream parchment frame.
formatted_prompt: Editorial ink-and-watercolor illustration, richly pigmented, vertical 3:4 card-face composition. A Before Times relic dominates the upper frame — an impossible dark shard resting on a carved volcanic-glass pedestal, its surface etched with faintly phosphorescent serial characters "8H-H1Y0B" glowing pale green-white. Aurora-crystal shards arranged in a precise warding ring encircle the pedestal, each prismatic tip catching cool luminous cyan. Two lean adult emperor penguins in pale ice-plate and white ceremonial robes watch from a measured distance — narrow beaks, small attentive eyes, silver coronets, rank script inscribed in Chinese-influenced characters across their segmented plate. One raises a trembling wing-hand. A cold halo of wrongness radiates from the relic in faint prismatic shimmer, distorting the deep slate shadow behind it. Lower quarter: warm ochre-cream parchment ground, ghosted serial watermark beneath. Fine nib linework, saturated aurora-green and deep-ocean blue highlights, blacks clean and confident.
